one_liner: Part-time, grant-funded city social services job doing community outreach on substance-use prevention and recovery resources, plus case coordination and service planning.
fit_summary: Daniel's outreach skills, comfort with the public, policy knowledge, and Manassas residency fit the outreach and community-event side well. The case-management duties (writing service plans, presenting cases to funding teams) usually call for human services education or casework experience, which isn't on file, and a Specialist II title suggests some prior experience is expected.
eligibility: The minimum qualifications are cut off in the posting text. Read the full posting for required education (often a degree in social work, human services, or a related field) and years of experience.
Specialist II level may require prior family services or case management experience. Confirm whether consulting or emergency-management work counts.
Expect background checks, possibly including a Virginia Child Protective Services registry check and a driver's license requirement. Verify these in the full posting.
No federal status, veterans' preference, or clearance is indicated. This is open local government hiring through GovernmentJobs.
strategy: Apply right away, because the posting is open until filled and may close at any time. Its listed opening date is 2026-09-30, so check that the application link is live.

Complete every supplemental question in detail, matching the posting's wording. GovernmentJobs screeners often score these answers, and local applications are not bound by the two-page federal limit.
